data: Is the accuracy of the red line lower than the accuracy of the blue line when two words are deleted in the plot on the right?

The question asks whether the accuracy of the red line is lower than the accuracy of the blue line when two words are deleted in the plot on the right. 

From the caption, we know that the left plot shows the impact of deleting words in decreasing order of their relevance, while the right plot shows the impact of deleting words in increasing order of their relevance. The caption also mentions that the relevance target class is the true sentence class, and words are deleted in decreasing (left) and increasing (right) order of their relevance.

In the right plot, the red line represents the accuracy for the SA method, and the blue line represents the accuracy for the LRPcons method. The green line represents the accuracy for the LRP method, and the black line represents the accuracy for random deletion.

Looking at the right plot, when two words are deleted, the red line (SA) is below the blue line (LRPcons). This indicates that the accuracy of the red line is lower than the accuracy of the blue line when two words are deleted in the plot on the right.
